messages: Mia: Quick poll: should we standardize required indicators across the console or adapt per surface? thinking lists vs full forms + destructive confirms (typed-confirm vs modal+undo). cc @Sam @Jordan Sam: Leaning surface-adaptive. lists = minimal (mark only optional), full forms = explicit "Required" badge. less visual noise. Jordan: A11y reminder: visual markers need programmatic equivalents. add aria-required and sr-only copy. small example: required Ana: Error UX: inline error near field + optional top summary for long forms (>6 fields). summary should link to fields and focus the first invalid input. Kevin: Destructive: typed-confirm for irreversible org-level actions only. item deletes = modal + undo toast. on mobile, avoid typed-confirm (painful) 1; use checkbox + confirm CTA instead. Priya: Microcopy: prefer short, actionable lines. e.g. 'Enter a valid email' then hint. For required badges use single word: 'Required'. DesignBot: Note: when >80% fields required show banner "All fields are required unless marked optional" and label only optional ones. Mia: Action items: produce 3 mocks: (1) dense list (optional-mark-only), (2) full form (required-pill + inline errors + top summary), (3) destructive flow with desktop typed-confirm and mobile fallback. assign owners? Sam: I'll do (1) and quick CSS for pill. Kevin: I'll own (3) and include keyboard/screen-reader flows + undo spec (5s with dismiss). Ana: I'll wire (2) with error summary anchors. Jordan: I'll draft the a11y checklist for the docs. Priya: I'll prepare microcopy variants and error tone examples. Mia: Great 1 I'll make the ticket and link mocks. Aim to finalize before sprint end. :sparkles:
